afterglow-theme.notes: The theme provides CSS variables used by the materials. Import your Tailwind CSS stylesheet once at the application root. Accent Picker demonstrates changing the shared accent at runtime.

accent-picker.notes: The selected accent is shared through CSS variables and persisted locally. Mount one visible picker in your interface.

border-beam.notes: Place the beam inside a positioned, rounded parent. Turning active off lets its tail fade instead of removing it abruptly.

copy-button.notes: Use a secure browser context for clipboard access. The icon confirms a successful copy; onCopy runs after the clipboard write.

glass-switch.notes: Use checked and onCheckedChange for controlled state. Give the switch an accessible name. Space toggles the focused switch.

liquid-switch.notes: Use checked and onCheckedChange for controlled state. Give the switch an accessible name. Space toggles the focused switch.

glass-slider.notes: The default range is 0–100. Use min, max, and step for a different range; onValueCommit runs when the adjustment is committed.

liquid-slider.notes: The default range is 0–100. Use min, max, and step for a different range; onValueCommit runs when the adjustment is committed.

gloss-button.notes: Use the ember variant for an emphasized action and glass for a secondary action. Standard button attributes are supported.

liquid-button.notes: The glass swells while pressed. The component accepts standard button events and attributes.

fan-cards.notes: Cards fan out on larger screens and form a grid in narrow containers. Hover or focus a card to bring it forward.

liquid-glass.notes: Place the glass below a separate content layer. Refraction is supported in Chromium; other browsers receive frosted glass. Set refraction to zero for native blur. Avoid animating ancestor opacity around refracting glass.

liquid-card.notes: Pass material options through the glass prop. The card stays flat so the backdrop filter remains connected to the scene.

liquid-segmented.notes: Use a controlled value to update related content. Choices have stable values and labels. Use arrow keys to move between tabs or segments.

liquid-tabs.notes: Use a controlled value to update related content. Choices have stable values and labels. Use arrow keys to move between tabs or segments.

trail-tabs.notes: Use a controlled value to update related content. Choices have stable values and labels. Use arrow keys to move between tabs or segments.

liquid-toolbar.notes: Give icon actions a label. Use pressed for toggle actions and insert divider entries between groups. Arrow keys move between toolbar buttons.

liquid-menu.notes: Use triggerLabel for an icon-only trigger. The menu supports arrow keys, Home, End, Escape, and selection with Enter. onSelect connects each action to your application.

magnetic-dock.notes: The pointer enlarges nearby tiles. Set size, magnification, and range to suit your available space. Each item needs a label and can provide an action.

rail-nav.notes: Use value and onValueChange for a controlled sidebar. Entries can include href to become real links. Heading entries separate groups.

reading-rail.notes: Match IDs to headings in the scrolling container. Omit container to track the page. The rail follows nested depths and respects reduced motion.

scroll-rail.notes: Targets use data-rail-id. Every dash has the same short resting length; nearby marks expand toward the pointer, and the active mark brightens without growing. Pass the scrollable element as container; hover to inspect a block and select it to jump.

glass-sidebar.notes: A continuous seam opens around the hovered or focused row, then rejoins below it. One damped spring drives the contour and its fill together, so the line can reverse smoothly and return to the selected page. Search filters grouped links. Supports href, controlled selection, custom header and footer, keyboard navigation, and reduced motion.

glass-toaster.notes: Mount one toaster in your application. Call toast from client interactions. Toasts can be dismissed and are announced as status updates.

flame-field.notes: Give the field a positioned parent with an explicit height. It follows the shared accent and theme, and becomes still under reduced motion.

liquid-metal.notes: Set dimensions on the wrapper. Multiple pieces share a GPU context. Lower quality for smaller decorative surfaces; pattern silk produces diagonal folds.

metal-button.notes: Choose rim for a dark surface with a chrome edge or silver for brushed metal. Standard button attributes are supported.

metal-card.notes: The frame prop controls the width of the metallic edge. Give the card its shape and spacing through className.

metal-text.notes: Use for short display text. The every prop controls the interval between glints. Preserve an accessible text label when styling decorative content.

auth-silk.notes: The preview simulates submission only. Connect onSubmit to your authentication service and onProvider to your OAuth flow. Never place provider secrets in client code. Errors thrown by onSubmit are shown by the form.

auth-glass.notes: The preview simulates submission only. Connect onSubmit to your authentication service and onProvider to your OAuth flow. Never place provider secrets in client code. Errors thrown by onSubmit are shown by the form.

auth-split.notes: The preview simulates submission only. Connect onSubmit to your authentication service and onProvider to your OAuth flow. Never place provider secrets in client code. Errors thrown by onSubmit are shown by the form.

auth-steps.notes: The preview simulates submission only. Connect onSubmit to your authentication service and onProvider to your OAuth flow. Never place provider secrets in client code. Errors thrown by onSubmit are shown by the form.

liquid-search.notes: A reusable liquid search input with a frosted capsule and a glass lens around the search icon. Focus uses your accent color. The clear button and Escape reset the query and keep focus in the field. Supports controlled or uncontrolled values, disabled and read-only states, native input attributes, and an input ref. Uses flat frosting to avoid expensive refraction maps while typing.
